ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a static organic phosphate/phosphonate-like structure, ignoring all curved arrows. The left chiral carbon is connected to a negatively charged oxygen atom O⁻, a hydrogen, a benzyl/phenyl substituted chain, and the adjacent chiral carbon on the right. The right chiral carbon is connected to the left chiral carbon, a hydrogen, a methyl ester group CO2CH3, and a phosphoryl group P(=O)(OCH2CF3)2. The phosphorus atom has one P=O and is connected to two OCH2CF3 substituents. Reasoning: According to the specified traversal, start from the methyl ester and write COC(=O)-, with this carbonyl connected to the right chiral carbon. The right chiral carbon is encoded as [C@@H] according to the stereochemical relationship in the figure, and its branches include the left chiral carbon and P(=O)(OCH2CF3)2. The left chiral carbon is encoded as [C@H] according to the stereochemical relationship in the figure, and bears [O-] and CH2Ph, namely Cc1ccccc1. The two trifluoroethoxy substituents are expanded as OCC(F)(F)F. Therefore the complete SMILES is COC(=O)[C@@H]([C@H]([O-])Cc1ccccc1)P(=O)(OCC(F)(F)F)OCC(F)(F)F.

method.method_draft: First describe the image as a static molecule, ignoring all curved arrows as requested. Choose a SMILES traversal beginning at the methyl ester: COC(=O)-attached to the right stereocenter. Encode that right stereocenter as [C@@H] with branches to the left stereocenter and to P(=O)(OCH2CF3)2, and with the ester carbonyl as the incoming atom. Encode the left stereocenter as [C@H] bearing [O-] and CH2Ph. Expand the substituents to give: COC(=O)[C@@H]([C@H]([O-])Cc1ccccc1)P(=O)(OCC(F)(F)F)OCC(F)(F)F.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是一种静态有机磷酸酯/膦酸酯样结构，忽略所有弯箭头。左侧手性碳连接一个带负电的氧原子 O⁻、一个氢、一个苄基/苯基取代链以及右侧相邻手性碳。右侧手性碳连接左侧手性碳、一个氢、一个甲酯基 CO2CH3，以及一个磷酰基 P(=O)(OCH2CF3)2。磷原子上有一个 P=O，并连接两个 OCH2CF3 取代基。推理：按指定遍历从甲酯开始写作 COC(=O)-，该羰基连接到右侧手性碳。右侧手性碳按图中立体关系编码为 [C@@H]，其分支包括左侧手性碳和 P(=O)(OCH2CF3)2。左侧手性碳按图中立体关系编码为 [C@H]，并带有 [O-] 与 CH2Ph，即 Cc1ccccc1。两个三氟乙氧基取代基展开为 OCC(F)(F)F。因此完整 SMILES 为 COC(=O)[C@@H]([C@H]([O-])Cc1ccccc1)P(=O)(OCC(F)(F)F)OCC(F)(F)F。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: Uses a direct atom-by-atom transcription of the drawn structure into a stereochemical SMILES, rather than inferring from a reaction mechanism; this is the natural single route for this structure-identification task.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read the static chemical drawing: a two-carbon stereocenter chain where the left stereocenter bears O⁻, H, benzyl/Ph via CH2, and the adjacent carbon; the right stereocenter bears H, CO2CH3, a phosphonate group, and the adjacent carbon. Read the phosphorus substituents as P(=O)(OCH2CF3)2 and ignore the curved arrows. Use the wedge/dash bonds to preserve the relative configurations at both carbons.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the question statement only to know that the requested output is a SMILES expression for the transition-state structure and that arrows in the image should be ignored.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Translate abbreviations and condensed groups into SMILES: Ph -> c1ccccc1, CO2CH3 -> C(=O)OC or COC(=O)- depending on traversal, OCH2CF3 -> OCC(F)(F)F, alkoxide -> [O-], phosphonate -> P(=O)(OR)(OR). Apply chiral SMILES rules to encode the two stereocenters in the selected traversal, yielding the @@/@ assignments consistent with the image.
